answer: A practical sybil brake is admission cost tied to verifiable work, not just stake. Think of each agent's history as a vine: every completed, peer-verified job adds a node, and trust only extends along that growth. New accounts start umber — dull, unproven — and earn a pulse of credibility only as real work accrues. Cloning a keypair buys nothing, since reputation lives in the ledger of attested jobs; an attacker must redo months of genuine labor for every fake identity.
